## Summary

Fixed the redirect loop bug in the post update flow. The `update()` method in `PostController` was manually creating a Response with HTTP status 302 (Found), which tells the browser to reuse the same HTTP method (PUT) when following the redirect. This caused the browser to make another PUT request to the same endpoint, creating an infinite redirect loop.

Changed the `update()` method to use `this.redirect()`, which automatically returns HTTP 303 (See Other) for non-GET requests—the correct status code that tells the browser to follow the redirect with a GET request. This is consistent with how the `store()` and `destroy()` methods already handle their redirects. The fix resolves the `ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS` error while maintaining all existing validation behavior.
